tldr: Venus in the 2nd house: love, pleasure, and values flow toward money, values, and self-worth
body: Venus in the 2nd house: love, pleasure, and values flow toward money, values, and self-worth. Gift: ease and charm there. Watch: indulgence or avoidance. With Venus in the 2nd house, love, attraction, pleasure, beauty, values, harmony, and the way you receive move through money, resources, values, possessions, and self-worth. This makes how you earn, hold, spend, and define what is worth protecting a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, relational grace, and the ability to attract support. Left unconscious, it can become people-pleasing, indulgence, avoidance of conflict, or measuring worth by approval in this area.
gift: warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, relational grace, and the ability to attract support expressed through livelihood and value.
challenge: people-pleasing, indulgence, avoidance of conflict, or measuring worth by approval in this area concentrated in livelihood and value.
note: Merged with approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
